title: S9 — the product path: every auto probe under 10s, clean-clone smoke of typer+demo, non-programmer README
desc: Make superocr fully functional end to end. Fix auto-mode latency (strippy 26.0s and split 12.4s exceed the 10s bar today; the documented fix path is a cheap pre-classifier to skip chains, or faster strippy/split processing). Clean-clone smoke test of typer + demo + bench (commands from README actually run). A README a non-programmer can follow. Numbers stay measured and labeled; no promises without a report.
